acceptanceCriteria: a 'Transport by Provider' card appears on the dashboard below the category breakdown
the card shows the top 3 transport merchants ranked by spend amount
remaining transport merchants are grouped into a single 'Other' row
each row shows merchant name, amount, and a percentage bar relative to total transport spend
the card updates when the period filter changes
the card is hidden when there are no transport transactions in the selected period
THB and IDR transport breakdowns are shown independently under their respective currency sections
notes: Query TransactionEntity directly (not MonthlyOverviewEntity) for merchant-level data. THB = wallet IS NULL OR wallet = 'BBL'. IDR = wallet IS NOT NULL AND wallet != 'BBL'. Top N = 3.
